difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for morphisms f : X -> Y and g : Y -> Z of algebraic spaces over S, if g o f is quasi-compact and g is quasi-separated then f is quasi-compact (source lines 1452-1458). The proof factors f as the graph (1, f) : X -> X x_Z Y followed by the projection to Y: the graph is a section of the base change of g, hence quasi-compact because a section of a quasi-separated morphism is quasi-compact, and the projection is a base change of g o f, hence quasi-compact; the composite of quasi-compact morphisms is quasi-compact.
